image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a common iguana (Iguana iguana). The image focuses on the head and upper torso. The iguana has textured, granular scales in shades of grey-green and brown. A prominent dorsal crest runs along the neck. The eye is visible with a reddish-orange iris. A large subtympanic shield is visible below the ear area. The background is a soft, out-of-focus blur.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight crop focusing on the head and shoulders. The throat area where the dewlap hangs is largely occluded by the angle and framing, making it impossible to verify the full extent or prominence of the dewlap.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is large, clearly shows a round pupil, and has an orange-golden iris color consistent with adult iguanas.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, large, circular scale pattern is clearly visible on the cheek/jaw area, matching the description of the subtympanic shield.
The visible portion of the torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust body structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-green with darker banding patterns, consistent with an adult common iguana. It is not the bright green of a juvenile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A clear row of spiky, spine-like scales is visible running down the back of the neck and continuing onto the upper back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is highly detailed, showing fine granular scales on the body and larger, irregular plate-like scales on the snout and head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs and feet are completely outside the frame or occluded by the body in this close-up shot. Digits cannot be counted or verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this cropped image.
